description.narrative: Biota Nutri B.V. develops and produces 100% organic fertilisers, based on vegetable residual flows. These fertilisers have no negative impact on the environment, because they cause no soil degradation, reduce waste, improve growers' returns and provide healthier fruit and vegetables. Biota Nutri wants to apply its technology in other countries, and Uganda seems a suitable country to set up a local entity that will produce organic fertilisers, granules and liquid, from locally obtained residual flows. Local residual flows include lakeweeds such as water hyacinths that suffocate the ecosystem in lakes, elephant grass and residual products from potato, sugar cane and coffee production.Biota Nutri's choice for Uganda is clear:• Uganda has no seaport. The import of fertilisers is therefore expensive.• There are no affordable organic fertilisers available in Uganda.• The land is very fertile and has a lot of arable farming. The use of fertilisers is still very low. The market is big.• The year-round local farming supplies many free residual flows.• Biota Nutri already has many contacts with Dutch agricultural companies, suppliers and buyers established in Uganda.Because Biota Nutri uses local residual flows as raw materials, it is possible to offer organic fertilisers at a competitive price. A small trial production will be part of this DHI project to see how can be worked with the various new local residual flows and to investigate what amount of nutrients the various residual flows contain and which fertiliser granules work best. The fertilisers obtained will be tested and validated by a local knowledge institution and then tested at local growers. Biota's experts will provide technical advice to farmers on how to use the fertilisers most efficiently.
